seoTitle: Fix Black Highlight Covers & Edit Them on Instagram PC
metaDescription: Fix Instagram highlight covers appearing as a solid black box, and edit highlight covers directly from your computer.
intro: Highlight covers turning into a solid black box on Instagram's desktop site usually comes down to browser caching issues or a file format mismatch, and editing highlights created on mobile can be trickier from a computer. This guide covers clearing the cause of the black cover glitch and re-uploading a working cover from your PC.

steps.heading: Understand why covers turn black on PC
steps.body: This glitch is often caused by a browser caching error or a mismatch between the file format of your cover image and what the desktop interface expects.

steps.heading: Access highlight settings on desktop
steps.body: Open Instagram in your browser and navigate to your profile's highlights section to locate the edit option for the affected highlight.

steps.heading: Clear browser cache and cookies
steps.body: Clear your browser's site-specific cookies and cached data for Instagram, then reload the page before attempting to edit the cover again.

steps.heading: Upload a correctly sized cover
steps.body: Re-upload your custom graphic in the correct aspect ratio to avoid the black cover error reappearing.

steps.heading: Sync and verify
steps.body: After saving, refresh your profile and check that the new cover displays correctly and syncs across devices.

faq.question: Why does my highlight cover show as a black box on desktop?
faq.answer: It's typically due to a browser caching error or the uploaded image not matching the expected file format or aspect ratio.

faq.question: Can I edit highlight covers directly from my computer?
faq.answer: Yes, Instagram's desktop interface allows editing, though highlights originally created on mobile can sometimes be more restricted.

faq.question: Will clearing my browser cache fix the black cover issue?
faq.answer: In many cases yes, since clearing cached data and cookies removes the stale files causing the display error.

faq.question: What image size should I use for a highlight cover?
faq.answer: Use the correct aspect ratio Instagram expects for highlight covers to avoid display errors when uploading from a computer.
